display_name: Theodore the Hadji of Mytilene, New Martyr

names.form: Άγιος Θεόδωρος ο Χατζής ο Μυτιληναίος

death.note: saint.gr: hanged by the Turks at Mytilene in 1785.

attestations.note: Not on the Moscow Patriarchate’s list for 4 September (Julian) — days.pravoslavie.ru, read 2026-08-23; no other day checked.
Not on doxologia.ro’s list for 4 septembrie (checked 2026-08-23); no other day checked.

feast.note: The finding of his relics (4 September 1967), as saint.gr keeps it; his martyrdom is kept on 30 January.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 4 Σεπτεμβρίου — «Εύρεσις των Τιμίων Λειψάνων του νεομάρτυρος Θεοδώρου του Χατζή του Μυτιληναίου»
